lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Two weeks ago, Su Hai wanted to play Mulan in a school play.
lines.chinese: 两周前，苏海想在学校戏剧中扮演木兰。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: It was her first school play.
lines.chinese: 这是她第一次学校戏剧表演。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: She wanted to try her best.
lines.chinese: 她想尽她最大的努力。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: There were a lot of words in the play.
lines.chinese: 戏剧里有很多台词。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: She asked Su Yang to practise with her.
lines.chinese: 她请苏阳和她一起练习。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: There were also a lot of movements.
lines.chinese: 还有很多动作。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: She used her dancing skills to do them well.
lines.chinese: 她运用自己的舞蹈技巧把它们做好。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Su Hai was afraid of acting in front of many people.
lines.chinese: 苏海害怕在许多人面前表演。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: She asked her family to watch her practise.
lines.chinese: 她请家人观看她练习。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Su Hai practised a lot.
lines.chinese: 苏海练习了很多次。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: She remembered all the words and movements.
lines.chinese: 她记住了所有台词和动作。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: She was ready.
lines.chinese: 她准备好了。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Finally, it was time for the play.
lines.chinese: 最后，戏剧表演的时候到了。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Su Hai acted well. It was great!
lines.chinese: 苏海表演得很好。太棒了！

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Last week, Bobby and Sam saw a new poster at school.
lines.chinese: 上周，博比和萨姆在学校看到了一张新海报。

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: I'm not good at singing.
lines.chinese: 我不擅长唱歌。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.english: But you like singing! Have a go!
lines.chinese: 但是你喜欢唱歌！试一试吧！

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Bobby practised in the morning, in the afternoon and in the evening.
lines.chinese: 博比在早上、下午和晚上都练习。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: First he was afraid, but then he calmed down.
lines.chinese: 起初他很害怕，但后来他冷静了下来。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: First he forgot the words, but then he remembered them.
lines.chinese: 起初他忘了台词，但后来想起来了。

lines.speaker: Everyone
lines.english: You were great, Bobby!
lines.chinese: 你太棒了，博比！

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: I want to sing again next year!
lines.chinese: 我想明年再唱歌！
